purpose: Chase requested a frame-by-frame 2D Eave Runner study matching the original demo enemy sprites; supersedes the front/back 3D-generation reference request.

prompts.idle:
Transform the Eave Runner design in the input references into a professionally drawn frame-by-frame 2D GAME SPRITE IDLE ANIMATION SHEET matching the existing demo enemy art. Transparent background (real alpha). No scenery, ground, shadow, text, numbers, boxes, cell borders, checkerboard, watermark or annotations.

REFERENCES: Image 1 = the authoritative established Eave Runner character concept. Image 2 = actual existing demo enemy sprites, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: fine dark ink detail inside strong irregular black silhouettes, muted ivory and charcoal with limited material shading, hand-drawn 2D fantasy sprites. Image 3 = current Eave Runner model, supporting anatomy and garment reference only, not a 3D rendering style target. Do not copy the other enemy designs from image 2. Depict ONE Eave Runner repeated across animation frames.

CRITICAL OUTPUT LAYOUT: EXACTLY EIGHT complete frames on a uniform FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid. Wide landscape sheet, 3:2 aspect. Each cell has identical width and height, completely transparent gutters. Each character fully fits its own cell with generous margins including weapon and cloth tails. No overlap between cells. Read left to right, top row then bottom row. All figures are the SAME size and have the SAME ground baseline in their cells; no camera zoom, perspective changes, sliding or resizing. Head height and feet stay consistent. ALL EIGHT face SCREEN RIGHT in a side/very slight three-quarter gameplay view. Do NOT turn toward viewer or switch sides.

CHARACTER: lean agile adult-proportioned woven assassin, dark braided cord arms and shins and articulated dark cord fingers. An aged ivory pointed oval ceramic face mask inside a close indigo hood, narrow black eye slits and tiny restrained cyan glint, a single diagonal crack and small paired-loop forehead binding emblem. Indigo wrapped scarf with TWO short cloth tails flowing behind toward LEFT, overlapping blue diagonal chest wraps on charcoal undershirt, short layered shoulder cloth, tan cord belt with paired binding knot, short asymmetric waist cloth tabs, loose charcoal knee-length gathered trousers tied at knees, thin cord shins, bound dark sandals. Closely fitted weathered warm-brown bamboo/wood forearm bracers bound with flax cord. One SHORT simple steel dagger held in the forward RIGHT hand pointed down/right, clearly distinct from forearm and leg. Free LEFT hand relaxed behind. No long sword, enormous blade, armor knight, fleshy human limbs, skeleton or wooden doll.

POSE AND EIGHT IDLE FRAMES: restrained predatory ready stance facing right, knees softly bent, front right foot and rear left foot PLANTED in EXACTLY the same positions in every frame. Full coherent breathing cycle: frame1 relaxed neutral; frame2 tiny chest inhale and scarf lift; frame3 inhale; frame4 top of inhale; frame5 release; frame6 lower; frame7 settle; frame8 near-neutral ready to loop back to1. Shoulder, head and blade move only a few pixels, no stepping, no huge squash/stretch. Scarf tails lag the breathing very subtly. Each frame is a genuine hand-drawn animation drawing, coherent body volumes and consistent mask details. NO duplicates of a full scene or turnaround views.

STYLE: actual production-ready inked 2D sprite artwork, bold clear dark contour, crisp antialiased edges, broad 2-3 shade value shapes per material, selective tiny woven marks and chips, muted dark indigo and charcoal, ivory mask as focal point, tan bindings. Match the demo's delicate inner ink and readable silhouette without noisy 3D material grain. Not pixel art, not a rendered 3D model, not painterly concept art, not chibi. Readable at approximately 180px character height in gameplay. Use enough large empty transparent margin around every figure to prevent clipping when slicing the uniform grid.
